items.headline: Worker, 23, killed by falling formwork at Jurong Port construction site
items.summary: A 23-year-old worker died on Aug 4 after a formwork structure fell from an upper storey onto a lorry at 30 Jurong Port Road; MOM ordered the main contractor to halt all formwork activity.

items.headline: Nine people charged in Singapore over the sexual exploitation of two minors
items.summary: Nine people were charged on Aug 3 after CID probed the exploitation of two victims under 18; a 20-year-old woman faces five charges including trafficking for exploitation.

items.headline: Two charged over a spate of at least 10 loanshark harassment cases island-wide
items.summary: A 19-year-old Malaysian and a 25-year-old Indonesian were charged on Aug 4 under the Moneylenders Act after doors were splashed with paint on Aug 2; police link them to at least 10 cases.

items.headline: Singaporean motorcyclist, 56, dies after a collision on a Johor expressway
items.summary: A 56-year-old Singaporean man died after his motorcycle collided with a vehicle on an expressway in Johor, Malaysia.

items.headline: India coverage is unavailable in today's edition
items.summary: All six primary India outlets were unreachable from the routine network, and permitted fallback outlets carried no fresh, non-duplicate India-domestic story in the 48-hour window.

items.headline: Update: Burnham bars rapists and child-sex offenders from early-release scheme
items.summary: PM Andy Burnham confirmed on Aug 3 that rape, serious child-sex and grooming offences are excluded from the Sentencing Act early-release scheme, whose start moves from September to Oct 1, with GPS tagging for rapists.

items.headline: Update: Essex and Suffolk Water declares its first hosepipe ban since 1997 as drought spreads
items.summary: A temporary use ban took effect from Aug 3 for Essex & Suffolk Water customers, its first since 1997, after the Environment Agency declared drought across East Anglia and the South East.

items.headline: FTSE 100 hits a record high near 10,980 on mining strength and Iran-deal optimism
items.summary: The FTSE 100 rose about 0.4% on Aug 5 to a record close near 10,925, touching an intraday peak close to 10,980, led by miners and buoyed by hopes of US-Iran de-escalation.

items.headline: Britain's services firms cut jobs for a 22nd straight month as the growth push stalls
items.summary: S&P Global's PMI showed UK services companies cutting headcount for a 22nd consecutive month in July, underlining a two-year jobs downturn that complicates Burnham's growth pledge.

items.headline: Russian missile-and-drone barrage on the Kyiv region kills 17 and wounds 44
items.summary: Overnight into Aug 5, Russia fired 24 ballistic missiles, several Zircon or Oniks missiles and about 115 drones at Kyiv, killing 17 and wounding 44; warehouses of Epicentr K and Nova Post were hit as Patriot interceptors run short.

items.headline: Update: US, Iran and Oman edge toward an interim deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz
items.summary: Iran and Oman have agreed coordinates for a safe shipping route and Trump said a deal could come within days, though an official put the odds at about 50-50 by Friday; talks stick on Iranian transit tolls.

items.headline: Israel-Lebanon talks in Rome stall over Hezbollah disarmament in a seventh round
items.summary: Technical teams met in Rome on Aug 4 and 5 for a seventh round since the April ceasefire but stayed split on disarming Hezbollah and any Israeli withdrawal from southern Lebanon.

items.headline: Gaza Board of Peace says there will be no Israeli withdrawal before Hamas disarms
items.summary: The US-backed Board of Peace said on Aug 4 that Israel will not withdraw from Gaza until Hamas surrenders weapons in stages; Hamas says it will not act unless Israel meets withdrawal obligations.

items.headline: Jeff Dean and top Google researchers quit to launch AI-for-science startup Discovery Loop
items.summary: Google chief scientist Jeff Dean is leaving after nearly 27 years to co-found Discovery Loop with Sanjay Ghemawat, Oriol Vinyals and Quoc Le; Radical and Khosla co-lead the seed round with Alphabet a founding investor.

items.headline: Meta launches Muse Code, an AI coding agent that undercuts Anthropic and OpenAI on price
items.summary: Meta debuted Muse Code, a terminal agent for large codebases powered by Muse Spark 1.2, in public beta for macOS and Linux at $1.25 per million input and $4.25 per million output tokens.

items.headline: US drafts a ban on Chinese data-center components to protect AI infrastructure
items.summary: The Trump administration, via the FCC, is drafting a ban on imports of new Chinese optical transceivers and data-center hardware; China's Innolight holds about 27% of the global transceiver market.

items.headline: White House summons OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Nvidia on an AI safety-testing framework
items.summary: Frontier labs were called to the White House for an Aug 6 meeting on a voluntary framework giving agencies up to 30 days of secure early access to covered frontier models before release.

items.headline: Disney beats on fiscal Q3 as streaming profit more than doubles to $712 million
items.summary: Disney posted adjusted EPS of $2.06 on revenue up 7% to about $25.2 billion; streaming operating income jumped to $712 million from $329 million, helped by parks and Toy Story 5.

items.headline: Shopify jumps about 26% as second-quarter revenue climbs 34% to $3.58 billion
items.summary: Shopify reported Q2 revenue of $3.58 billion, up 34% and above consensus, with EPS of $0.42 and GMV up 32% to $115.6 billion; AI-attributed orders roughly tripled year over year.

items.headline: Caterpillar tops $20 billion in quarterly revenue for the first time and lifts its outlook
items.summary: Caterpillar reported record Q2 revenue up 24% to $20.54 billion and adjusted EPS of $8.17, driven by construction and data-center power; backlog hit $72.1 billion and shares rose about 6%.

items.headline: Uber falls about 5% on soft guidance despite record free cash flow
items.summary: Uber posted Q2 revenue of $14.19 billion and adjusted EPS of $0.81, with gross bookings up more than 22% above $58 billion and trailing free cash flow topping $10 billion; light guidance hit the shares.

items.headline: Alcaraz withdraws from the Cincinnati Open, casting doubt on his US Open defence
items.summary: Carlos Alcaraz pulled out of the Cincinnati Masters (main draw Aug 13) as he recovers from a wrist injury that has kept him out since April; the US Open starts Aug 30.

items.headline: Tirante stuns seventh seed Fritz as seeds tumble at the Montreal Masters
items.summary: Argentina's Thiago Tirante upset seventh seed Taylor Fritz 7-5, 6-3 in the second round of the National Bank Open on Aug 5, as Shang Juncheng saved five match points to beat 10th seed Andrey Rublev.

items.headline: Buttler becomes T20 cricket's all-time leading run-scorer in The Hundred
items.summary: Jos Buttler passed Kieron Pollard's 14,803 to lead all T20 run-scorers, reaching 14,833 with an unbeaten 51 off 20 balls as Manchester Super Giants beat Welsh Fire at Old Trafford on Aug 5.

items.headline: Trent Rockets Women go top of The Hundred with a fourth straight win
items.summary: Trent Rockets Women beat Birmingham Phoenix Women by six wickets at Trent Bridge on Aug 5, chasing 123 with Sophia Dunkley player of the match for 65 off 37; the win took them top of the table.

items.headline: Ocon's Haas seat under threat as F2 champion Fornaroli emerges as a 2027 favourite
items.summary: With F1 in its summer break before the Dutch GP on Aug 21-23, Haas silly-season talk centres on Esteban Ocon, out-scored by rookie Ollie Bearman, with reigning F2 champion Leonardo Fornaroli a leading 2027 candidate.

items.headline: NASA's Big Bang power swap extends Voyager 2's interstellar science mission
items.summary: On Aug 4 JPL engineers completed a reconfiguration nicknamed the Big Bang that keeps Voyager 2's three remaining instruments running at least an extra year; the team plans the same swap on Voyager 1.

items.headline: A spent SpaceX Falcon 9 upper stage slams into the Moon near Einstein crater
items.summary: A leftover Falcon 9 upper stage struck the Moon at about 5,400 mph early on Aug 5, likely carving a 60-foot crater; telescopes detected sodium and lithium in the impact plume.

items.headline: Curiosity finds its largest-ever field of polygonal honeycomb fractures on Mars
items.summary: NASA's Curiosity rover imaged a vast field of honeycomb-like ground fractures in the Valle Grande area of Mount Sharp in Gale crater, the biggest such patch it has seen, possibly preserving clues to ancient water.

items.headline: A negative time quantum result clears peer review as photons appear to leave before entering
items.summary: A University of Toronto experiment led by Daniela Angulo, showing photons can register a negative dwell time in a cloud of atoms, has been published in Physical Review Letters; it is a quirk of quantum mechanics, not time travel.

fun_fact.headline: Australia lost the Great Emu War of 1932 to emus
fun_fact.body: In late 1932, Australia deployed soldiers with Lewis machine guns to cull emus destroying wheat crops in Western Australia; the roughly 20,000 birds scattered and fewer than 1,000 were confirmed killed before the operation was withdrawn.

puzzle.title: Trailing Off
puzzle.body: How many zeros are at the very end of 100! (the product of every whole number from 1 to 100)?
puzzle.approach: Count the factors of 5, since trailing zeros come from pairs of 2 and 5 and fives are scarcer.

word_puzzle.title: Something Fishy
word_puzzle.body: Sort 16 words (CAT SWORD WATER BASS JELLY RAIN PERCH KEY STAR WIND PIKE CARD FOOT SOLE DASH CLIP) into four groups of four.
word_puzzle.approach: Three groups take the same suffix (-fish, -fall, -board); one group is just fish.
word_puzzle.answer: -FISH: CAT SWORD JELLY STAR; -FALL: WATER RAIN WIND FOOT; -BOARD: KEY CARD DASH CLIP; Fish: BASS PERCH PIKE SOLE.

notes: India section is a placeholder: all six primary India outlets (The Hindu, Indian Express, Hindustan Times, Times of India, NDTV, Economic Times) were crawler-blocked/unreachable across 3+ attempts, and the fallback tier (SCMP, Al Jazeera, CNN, Bloomberg, CNBC) produced only already-published stories (RBI hold, Modi tax cuts) with no fresh non-duplicate India-domestic item in the window. UK ran partly on fallback source Bloomberg (2 of 4 items) as BBC/Sky deep links were largely unreachable for citation. All other sections met the 4-item floor on primary allowed sources.
